title: TCL 50DP660 (50DP660*, product "Percee TV", MediaTek MT5658 / board mt5891, armv7), Europe.
notes:
TCL 50DP660 (50DP660*, product "Percee TV", MediaTek MT5658 / board mt5891, armv7), Europe.
Android TV 8.0 (API 26), firmware V8-T658T01-LF1V602, build OTT1.180130.001.
Checked on a real TV; this list was applied and survived several reboots.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-50dp660/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-50dp660/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher is com.google.android.tvlauncher and it has HOME priority 2 on this firmware: it
must be disabled, or set-home-activity reports Success and HOME still lands on it. Install the
replacement launcher first, otherwise disable.sh will skip that line for its own HOME guard.
Live TV is com.tcl.tv, the tuner input is com.tcl.tvinput, HDMI and AV are com.tcl.tvpassthrough.

Factory menu from the remote, no software needed:
Settings > Picture > Advanced Settings > Brightness, highlight Contrast, type 1 9 5 0
then Other > ADB. Developer options > USB debugging must be on as well, or the RSA dialog never
appears and adb says "unauthorized". service.adb.tcp.port is preset to 5555 by the vendor, so
ADB comes up on the network, not USB.

WARNING - 1-Factory menu > NVM reset wipes the Wi-Fi MAC, the Widevine keybox and the Netflix
ESN. It is not a one-step operation: after the NVM reset do a factory data reset AND reflash the
full firmware over USB. Only the reflash re-provisions the vendor data; stopping earlier leaves a
02:00:00:00:00:00 Wi-Fi MAC and Netflix error -121 for good.

Keep these enabled (disabling any of them breaks something obvious):
com.tcl.inputmethod.international   the on-screen keyboard - no text input without it
com.tcl.tv, com.tcl.tvinput, com.tcl.tvpassthrough, com.tcl.sourcemananger
com.tcl.settings, com.tcl.autopair, com.tcl.virtualkey, com.tcl.factory.view
com.mediatek.wifi, com.mediatek.tunerservice, mtktvapi.agent
com.google.android.apps.mediashell  Google Cast receiver - keep it if you cast
com.google.android.backdrop         ambient screensaver
Stock launcher and its recommendation rows, replaced by launcher/
